en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5368 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni:

"Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) ruled regarding a man who came with fire and set it ablaze in the house of some people, causing the house, its inhabitants, and their belongings to burn.
Imam (as) said: 'He must compensate for the value of the house and everything in it, and then he is to be executed.'"
